subject: RFP: eDiscovery & bulk audit log handoff playbook
messages:
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@novacorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novacorp Legal Ops <legalops@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RFP question: bulk audit log delivery process and SLA

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the RFP response so far — quick follow-up from our security team. For procurement we need a concise playbook that describes how Redwood handles bulk export of audit logs for eDiscovery/incident response. Specifically:

- What export formats do you support (raw JSON, CSV, Parquet)?
- Can you produce a time-bounded snapshot and incremental delta exports?
- What's the expected lead time to produce a full 90-day audit package?
- How do you deliver (S3 presigned URLs, encrypted archive via partner transfer, direct FTPS)?
- What tamper-evidence and chain-of-custody metadata is included (checksums, signed manifests, timestamp authority)?
- Is there an attestation or notarized statement you can provide for the export?

We also need a sample manifest and a high-level runbook (steps, contacts, estimated effort). Can you attach a draft playbook and a sample schema for the logs?

Appreciate a response by EOD Tuesday (May 25).

Best,
Emily
Emily Ross
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager, Novacorp
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP question: bulk audit log delivery process and SLA

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. We put together an export playbook and sample artifacts that address each bullet. High level summary below; PDF and CSV schema attached.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Formats: JSON (line-delimited), CSV (columnar), Parquet (columnar compressed). Raw events are available in JSON; we produce CSV/Parquet derived exports on request.
- Snapshots & deltas: We support full point-in-time snapshots (time-bounded) and incremental delta exports based on sequence tokens/KV cache checkpoints. Deltas include starting sequence id + ending sequence id per shard.
- Lead time: Standard SLA for a 90-day full export is 3 business days; expedited (1 business day) available for an agreed fee.
- Delivery: Primary method is AES-256 encrypted tarball delivered to customer S3 (pre-created bucket + role) using server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) or presigned URLs for direct download. Alternative: secure SFTP or partner-managed transfer.
- Tamper-evidence & chain-of-custody: Exports include SHA256 checksums for each file, a signed manifest (PKCS#7) with export parameters, and optional notarized timestamp from our timestamp authority partner. We also provide an export activity log (who requested, service job id, start/end timestamps, worker node ids).
- Attestation: We can provide a standard export attestation letter on company letterhead and escalate to a notarized affidavit if required by legal.

Attached artifacts: redwood_ediscovery_playbook_v1.2.pdf (playbook), audit-log-schema-2027.csv (sample event schema), s3-transfer-checklist.xlsx (transfer readiness checklist).

Next steps:
1) If the schema looks good, share a test S3 bucket or test account and we can run a 7-day trial export.
2) Legal/ops can review the attestation language; we can draft and send for signature.

I copied Marissa and Laura for any technical/legal clarifications. Happy to jump on a 30-min call — what time zone is your ops team in?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@novacorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Novacorp Legal Ops <legalops@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 13:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP question: bulk audit log delivery process and SLA

Hi Emily — quick technical addendum from infra:

- Export unit economics & size: Typical compressed tarball for 90 days (combined API, auth, console traces) ranges 10–120GB depending on verbosity and whether debug-level telemetry was on. We include an export manifest with per-file uncompressed size, compressed size, and SHA256.
- Incremental deltas: We store monotonic sequence numbers per model instance; deltas are generated using a checkpoint token. Tokens are single-use for export jobs to guarantee immutability of the snapshot.
- Preservation & retention: We retain admin audit logs for 365 days by default for Hosted plans; longer retention windows available for Dedicated/Private customers through configurable retention policies.
- For forensics: we can produce a signed TAR with per-file PKCS#7 signatures and provide a short verification script (shasum + openssl verify) for your legal team.

Attachment notes: the CSV contains an example event row mapping. If you want field-level pseudonymization or redaction (PII), we can run a scrub job prior to export; this adds 1 business day.

-Marissa
Senior Product Security Eng., Redwood Inference
From: Novacorp Legal Ops <legalops@novacorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily.ross@novacorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP question: bulk audit log delivery process and SLA

Camila / Marissa,

Thanks — a few legal clarifications before we run any test exports:
1) Who will act as custodian of the signed manifest? We need an auditable contact with full name, role, and phone for chain-of-custody.
2) Please confirm retention windows for each log category (auth, API, console, admin) and provide any deletion/grace period policy that will apply to the exported copy post-delivery.
3) Do you support an immutable WORM-style export (object lock) on the delivered bucket for the 90-day sealed package?
4) Please share a draft attestation (PDF) and confirm your process for notarization — we will need to route to our counsel.

Can you respond with the requested points and an estimate for the test export (hours of engineering, calendar days)?

Regards,
Novacorp Legal Ops
(legalops@novacorp.com)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Novacorp Legal Ops <legalops@novacorp.com>, Emily Ross <emily.ross@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP question: bulk audit log delivery process and SLA

Hi Legal team — answers inline below and next steps at the end.

1) Custodian contact:
- Name: Marissa Cole
- Role: Senior Product Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
- Phone: +1 (415) 555-2410
We will include Marissa as the custodian in the signed manifest and she will be the point of contact for chain-of-custody questions.

2) Retention windows (hosted default):
- auth events: 365 days
- API request logs: 365 days
- console/admin UI traces: 180 days
- system/infra telemetry (agent heartbeats): 90 days
Export copies: once delivered to customer bucket, retention is controlled by customer policies. We can optionally set object-lock on our side for transfer staging for up to 30 days; for longer-term WORM you must enable object lock on the target bucket.

3) WORM-style export: We can support delivering a sealed package with the following options:
- Customer-managed object lock: we upload to customer bucket (recommended) and provide instructions for enabling Governance/Compliance mode.
- If customer requests, we can stage a sealed package in our transfer bucket with object lock enabled for up to 30 days while verification completes.

4) Attestation: Draft attestation attached to this message (see redwood_ediscovery_playbook_v1.2.pdf, appendix B). Notarization: we work with a timestamp authority and a third-party notary firm on request — typical lead time is 2–3 business days after signature.

Estimated effort for a 7-day trial export: 4 engineer-hours to prepare + 1 business day for job completion (including verification). For the full 90-day export under standard SLA: 2 engineer-hours + 3 business days processing. Expedited schedule reduces processing to 1 business day for a fee.

Planned next steps:
- We can run a sandbox export this week if you provide a test S3 bucket (ARN + temp role) or we can use our staging endpoint and share presigned URLs for verification.
- I have shared a DocuSign link for the export engagement form; please sign to confirm acceptance of fees/SLA: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-novacorp-transfer-agreement

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute call to walk through the manifest and sample verification script.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
